verdict.rationale: Logseq has a programmable surface. Plugins can be installed from the Marketplace or loaded unpacked, and a local HTTP API server dispatches any plugin-API method through `POST /api` with bearer-token auth and curl examples. However, the plugin API reference is explicitly described as community-driven documentation, and no named official SDK package or client library is evidenced. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and there is no versioning policy. Missing for 10: a named, first-party SDK/client library with official docs; OpenAPI/machine-readable spec; versioning/stability policy; independent hands-on corroboration of building against it.
